text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali chaired a cabinet meeting on administrative reform.
- President Ben Ali is expected to deliver a speech on Saturday at the start of the export high council meeting.

- Visitng Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa handed Ben Ali a message from his Egyptian counterpart Hosni Mubarak on bilateral relations, the Middle East peace process and the next Mediterranean meeting. Moussa ended on Friday a three-day visit to Tunis.
- Germany and Tunisia signed a loan agreement to finance small and medium irrigation projects.
- Visiting Algerian Secretary General of the General Union of Algerian Workers Abdelmajid Sidi Said meets his Tunisian counterpart Ismail Sahbani.
